compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh (HARD-GATE in fix-bug commit step) refuses commit when trailer absent, or matches>0 without per-match follow-up artifact (ticket id in trailer / match file in cached diff / "# antipattern-ok: <reason>" annotation in {different-context, dead-code, already-tracked:<id>}, capped 3/session); covers Phase G fix sub-agent commits; never gates other skills.

Create plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh, mirroring the structure of plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh (set -euo pipefail; SCRIPT_DIR/REPO_ROOT resolution; commit-msg-file resolution order $1 → $GIT_DIR/COMMIT_EDITMSG → git log -1). Gate ONLY when the .fix-bug-active marker exists at repo root (never gates other skills). When active: refuse (exit non-zero) if the Antipattern-Scan trailer is absent; when matches>0, require a per-match follow-up artifact — a ticket id embedded in the trailer, a match file present in the cached diff, or a '# antipattern-ok: <reason>' annotation whose reason is in {different-context, dead-code, already-tracked:<id>} — capped at 3 antipattern-ok annotations per session; exit 0 otherwise. Implement until tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh (task-2a) passes. Set the executable bit on the new hook.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] New hook is executable — Verify: test -x plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh
- [ ] Hook is bash -n clean — Verify: bash -n plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh
- [ ] task-2a test now passes GREEN — Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh
- [ ] Hook gates only under the .fix-bug-active marker (never gates other skills) — Verify: grep -q '.fix-bug-active' plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): [cross_task_interference] CRITICAL: check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh is registered globally at the commit-msg stage (task-3), so it fires on EVERY commit in the repo. It MUST early-exit 0 unless the .fix-bug-active marker (task-5a / 315a) is present — mirroring check-sprint-trailer.sh's 2-condition gate. Without this, once task-3 registers the hook it will reject all ordinary commits (sprint, docs, and the very commits building this feature) for lacking an Antipattern-Scan trailer. Marker-presence is the enforcement-scoping precondition.
